data.name: HARBINGER - Legacy Edition
data.detailed_description:
In 2030, humanity will be rattled by its inaction.

The wound left behind to fester has burst with its rot, and with it...

An enemy that alters the entire concept of life itself on its head...

They make their mark on the world through violent, ruthless attacks on civilization.

Who they really are is unknown, WHAT they really are is unknown...

But they've proven to have no interest in democracy, nor do they discriminate on the lives they alter and take.

Will you fight for the future of humanity? Or will you aid in the downfall of all life as we know it?

HARBINGER : Legacy Edition is an action horror adventure through the world ravaged by

bio-terror and cultic activity,

It features five separate playable modes,

including the Main Story, Instant Action, Infestation, Multiplayer, and The Extraction!

The start of it all, the very first attack led by the cult in the north-east city that was once your home.

Facing horrific abominations of science, you'll need to play smart to make it out alive.

Uncover the reality of the attack through four heart-pounding chapters,

spanning from the unkempt halls of your apartment complex, to secretive underground labs and toxic disposal facilities.

Operation Extraction is a go, the Bio-Terrorism Prevention Agency (B.T.P.A.) has located the site of an experimental organism being created by the cult that secretes a chemical which heals even the most grievous of wounds.

Play as the B.T.P.A.'s elite Zeta Team and acquire the organism for humanity and destroy the Cult's research,

Or play as the Cult's newest team of elites with heightened battle-senses and preserve your findings!

Regardless of your side, you'll need to play it slower and smarter to avoid risking your mission...

Following the scent of a prominent Cult Leader, you've walked right into his trap.
In this mode, you'll need to play smart--and fast. If you want to live long enough to make it out.
Choose between three unlock-able characters, each having their own specialized load-out.
Explore Four unique locations, each with their own secrets to be uncovered.
Kill as many of the infesting abominations as you can, rack up as many points as possible, and get out alive!

A classic Online Arena experience spanning around the world and the B.T.P.A.'s fight against the Cult.

Join one of the BTPA's many world-wide divisions to fight for humanity, or reject your sense of self for the Cult,

Its your choice, and we won't judge. (Much.)

Multiplayer Arena supports three modes, Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Infestation across eight different maps.

Supports up to six players.

Note : Multiplayer requires minor setup, consult the Manual for setup instructions.

The Multiplayer experience entirely offline with bots!

All it takes is to pick your mode, your map, and you've got an instant full match ready to go.

Supports all eight maps and all three game modes with slight alterations for the Singleplayer environment.

Bots will follow your commands, taunt dead players, and even run for health!

Get ready to shoot the works!

data.short_description: HARBINGER is a nightmarish action-horror adventure through the ruins of a north-eastern American city ravaged by an occult terrorist organization. In a world dominated by an advanced form of bio-terror, the only thing you can trust is the weapon by your side...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Athlon 64 X2 5200+ Dual Core 2.60 GHz / Intel Core 2 Duo E6420 Dual Core 2.13 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8800 GT 512MB or better / ATI Radeon HD 4830 512mb or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 24 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • VR Support: No Official VR Support
  • Additional Notes: Internet Connection ONLY required for Online Multiplayer. HDD/SSD Both supported.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes:
Harbinger centers around the horrific acts of a prominent, fictitious cult that utilizes its power to spread harm amongst the innocent. Harbinger largely shows the emotional impact they have during their attacks and activities.

This includes and is not limited to; Abduction, torture, inhumane-experimentation, brainwashing, suicide, and mass-murder.
